statusHistory.note: Operator request (chat, 2026-09-21): first Salvador, BA place page, part of a 5-post push. SAN is a longstanding LGBTQIA+ nightclub in Rio Vermelho — 4.1 stars across 483 Google reviews, R$80-100/person. Research floor: Google Maps listing verified live via browser (coordinates confirmed, R. Conselheiro Pedro Luiz 113 — an address that conflicts with an older mapalgbt.org citation of 488 and a Discodelia-adjacent 141 found for a different, now permanently-closed venue; Google Maps' own live listing is treated as authoritative per this pipeline's geocode convention). IMPORTANT catch: initial candidate venue for this Salvador push, Discodelia Pub & Records (also Rio Vermelho), was confirmed 'Permanentemente fechado' on Google Maps despite still-live-looking coverage from el Cabong and Sympla — dropped before drafting, not published closed. Reddit search for SAN returned no results (leg 2 of the UGC floor did not surface anything usable, tried both a general and site:reddit.com query); Google reviews (leg 3) read directly via Chrome: positive on music/DJs/space ('ambiente bonito espaçoso, bem organizado... música excelente, DJs incríveis'), one specific recurring complaint about bathroom conditions ('estrutura de banheiro EXTREMAMENTE PRECÁRIA'), both quoted in-body. Five-plus preferred-sources consulted: Google Maps, salvadordabahia.com, the venue's own Instagram, el Cabong (checked but had no direct SAN coverage — logged as a gap, not fabricated), Correio Nagô and Roda Cultural checked for general Rio Vermelho/nightlife context. A genuine dated event was found and nested on this page: Festa Brasileiragem com Melody, Oct 17 2026, 10pm-4am, open bar — well corroborated across two independent fetches of the same listing. A second Halloween-party lead ('Blessed', early Nov) had an internally inconsistent date (2024 vs 2026 across extraction passes) and was deliberately excluded rather than published on an unverified date. Operator directed hero images be real photos/official venue art, never AI-generated — used the venue's own official Instagram event-calendar graphic per that direction. Single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive.
